descriptionHtml:
The "IOT Technologies and Solutions" session, organized by the IEEE Communications Society Student Branch Chapter of University of Peradeniya, aimed to explore the latest developments and solutions in the field of Internet of Things (IoT). The session featured Dr. Indika Samarakoon, an esteemed expert in the IoT domain, as the keynote speaker. 

Dr. Indika Samarakoon discussed the latest trends and solutions in the IoT domain, emphasizing their impact on various industries and everyday life and Importance of security.

The event was successfully concluded with 80 participants who grabbed a vast knowledge on IoT Platforms.
